verification_policy: Direct research batch for an indexed skill whose acquisition and core mechanics can be cross-checked. Do not infer Ultimate Finish requirements or version-specific damage values when evidence is insufficient.
research_scope: Divine Kamehameha — Ki Blast Super acquisition and core behavior.

verification_audit.acquisition_finding: The current Xenoverse 2 reference identifies Divine Kamehameha as a TP Medal Shop skill. Historical community discussion independently reports the Ultra Instinct skill set becoming available through the TP Medal Shop, while noting that the shop rotation is time-dependent.
verification_audit.mechanics_finding: The current reference identifies Divine Kamehameha as a 200-Ki Ki Blast Super with forward movement during the charge, lateral movement control, an additional-input early release, and automatic firing when the user is hit during the forward movement. It also records a version-specific stamina-break restriction introduced with DLC 11.
verification_audit.probability_policy: No PQ drop probability or Ultimate Finish requirement is asserted because the researched acquisition evidence points to the TP Medal Shop rather than a PQ reward.
verification_audit.version_policy: Exact damage percentages and hit counts are not promoted as canonical because the available values are version/context-sensitive. The DLC 11 stamina-break behavior is retained as explicitly versioned evidence.

records.name: Divine Kamehameha
records.character_source: Goku (Ultra Instinct) and Goku (Ultra Instinct -Sign-); available to CaCs through the skill system
records.unlock_method: Purchase from the TP Medal Shop when available
records.skill_description: Charges a Kamehameha while moving forward, allowing lateral movement before firing; an additional input can fire immediately.
records.mechanics_notes: The current reference documents forward movement during the charge, left/right movement control, early firing through an additional input, and automatic movement toward the opponent and firing if the user is hit during the forward movement. It also states that, as of DLC 11, the move cannot be used while stamina broken.
records.pvp_notes: The current source documents movement and counter-like behavior, but no universal PvP performance ranking is asserted.
